proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL lattā subsection 1 explicitly gives Lahnda latt leg from hip to foot, Awankari lat and Punjabi latt leg; Kashmiri lath is also in this branch with kick sense. The selected northwestern lath/latʰ/ləṭʰ leg responses follow this regional leg family, preserving aspiration and dental/retroflex notation. The eastern latthā kick branch is not selected solely from surface h spelling. Regional transmission and phonetic history remain qualified, and no stick-to-leg semantic guess is required. Exact response: latʰ.
